key_employee_change_list.description: Capitolis appointed Murugan Manickam as CTO to lead its global engineering organization and data and AI strategy. He succeeds into the role as Amos Arev remains with the company.

key_employee_change_list.description: Capitolis appointed Ashwath Bhat as Chief Financial Officer, effective August 3, 2026. He will lead the global finance organization and succeed Lindsey Baptiste, who will remain as an adviser.

key_employee_change_list.description: Capitolis appointed Mary Messer as Head of North America Sales, reporting to the Global Head of Sales and leading bank and investor relationship growth across North America.

key_employee_change_list.description: Capitolis appointed Richard Schiffman as Chief Product Officer to lead product strategy and delivery, reporting to CEO and founder Gil Mandelzis.

key_employee_change_list.description: Capitolis appointed Melanie Carucci as Global Head of Sales, effective September 15, to lead global sales strategy and commercial growth.

key_employee_change_list.description: Capitolis has appointed Amol Naik as Chief Operating Officer (COO), effective May 5, 2025. Naik brings over 25 years of experience in financial services and fintech, previously serving as COO at Pagaya and as a Partner at Goldman Sachs. He will be responsible for managing Capitolis's day-to-day operations and supporting the company's growth strategy.

about_short_description.short_description: Capitolis is the financial technology company helping to create safer and more vibrant financial markets.

product.name: Portfolio Optimization
product.description: A capital-markets service that offsets or compresses redundant portfolio positions to reduce capital requirements, funding costs, and non-market risk for banks and institutional investors.

product.name: Capital Marketplace
product.description: A platform that connects banks with scalable origination capabilities to institutional investors seeking capital-market investment opportunities and diversified sources of funding.

product.name: Capitolis Novations
product.description: An automated foreign-exchange novation service that helps buy-side and sell-side firms reduce FX notional exposure by transferring contracts to suitable counterparties.
